# VTube Studio sub-actions

## Color tint

Tints your model with a color, for example red when someone is angry. Can tint all of it or only some parts.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Color** | The color as a hex code like #FF8080, or as numbers like "255,128,128" (red, green, blue, and optional see-through). Starts as: `#FF8080`. |
| **Art mesh names containing** | Only tint parts whose names contain these words. Separate several with commas. Leave both boxes empty to tint everything. |
| **Art mesh tags containing** | Only tint parts whose tags contain these words. Separate several with commas. |
| **Mix with scene lighting (0-1)** | How much the tint mixes with the scene lighting, from 0 to 1. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsMatchedArtMeshes%` | How many parts of the model were tinted |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.colorTint`</small>

## Get available models

Reads the list of models you have in VTube Studio and keeps it for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsModels%` | All model names, separated by commas |
| `%vtsModelCount%` | How many models there are |
| `%vtsModelsJson%` | The full list as raw text |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.getModels`</small>

## Get current model

Reads which model is loaded and where it is, and keeps the details for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsModelLoaded%` | True if a model is loaded |
| `%vtsModelName%` | The model's name |
| `%vtsModelId%` | The model's id |
| `%vtsPositionX%` | Left to right position |
| `%vtsPositionY%` | Bottom to top position |
| `%vtsRotation%` | Rotation in degrees |
| `%vtsSize%` | How big it is |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.getCurrentModel`</small>

## Get expressions

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsExpressions%` | All expression names, separated by commas |
| `%vtsActiveExpressions%` | The names of the expressions that are on now |
| `%vtsExpressionCount%` | How many expressions there are |
| `%vtsExpressionsJson%` | The full list as raw text |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.getExpressions`</small>

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.getHotkeys`</small>

## Load item

Puts an item (a prop or picture) into your VTube Studio scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item file** | The item's file name as VTube Studio shows it, like "star.png". |
| **Position X** | Left to right position (-1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge). Starts as: `0`. |
| **Position Y** | Bottom to top position (-1 is the bottom, 1 is the top). Starts as: `0`. |
| **Size (0-1)** | How big it is, from 0 to 1. Starts as: `0.32`. |
| **Rotation (degrees)** | How far to turn it, in degrees. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Fade time (seconds)** | How long it takes to fade in, in seconds. Starts as: `0.5`. |
| **Order** | Which layer it sits on, from -30 to 30. Leave empty to let VTube Studio pick a free one. |
| **Unload when Cuebot disconnects** | Tick to remove the item automatically if Cuebot disconnects from VTube Studio. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Save the answer in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the item's id, so you can move or remove it later. The default is vtsItemInstanceId. Starts as: `vtsItemInstanceId`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsItemInstanceId%` | The id of the new item (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.loadItem`</small>

## Load model

Switches VTube Studio to another model (avatar).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Model (name or id)** | The model name (or id) as VTube Studio shows it. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsModelId%` | The id of the model that was loaded |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.loadModel`</small>

## Move item

Moves, turns or resizes an item in your scene, smoothly.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item (instance id or file name)** | The item to move: its id (from Load item) or its file name. |
| **Time (seconds)** | How long the move takes, in seconds. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Motion** | How the motion feels: linear is steady, easeIn starts slow, easeOut ends slow, easeBoth does both, overshoot goes past and bounces back, zip is a quick snap. Options: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeBoth, overshoot, zip. Starts as: `easeBoth`. |
| **Position X** | Left to right position (-1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge). Leave empty to keep it. |
| **Position Y** | Bottom to top position (-1 is the bottom, 1 is the top). Leave empty to keep it. |
| **Size** | How big it is, from 0 to 1. Leave empty to keep it. |
| **Rotation** | How far to turn it, in degrees. Leave empty to keep it. |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.moveItem`</small>

## Move model

Moves, turns or resizes your model on screen, smoothly.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Time (seconds, 0-2)** | How long the move takes, in seconds (0 to 2). Starts as: `0.5`. |
| **Relative to the current position** | Tick to move from where the model is now. Untick to put it at exactly the numbers below. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Position X** | Left to right: -1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge. Leave empty to keep it. |
| **Position Y** | Bottom to top: -1 is the bottom, 1 is the top. Leave empty to keep it. |
| **Rotation (degrees)** | How far to turn it, in degrees (-360 to 360). Leave empty to keep it. |
| **Size** | How big it is (-100 to 100). Leave empty to keep it. |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.moveModel`</small>

## Move model parts (advanced)

Moves parts of your model yourself, like head angle or mouth opening, as if your face did it. Handy for scripted reactions.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Parameters** | What to move, as name=value, separated by commas or new lines, like "FaceAngleX=20, MouthOpen=1". Add @ and a number for how strongly, like "MouthOpen=1@0.5". |
| **Mode** | set replaces the value, add adds to what your face tracking is doing. Options: set, add. Starts as: `set`. |
| **Hold for (seconds)** | How long to keep the values applied, in seconds. Cuebot keeps re-sending them until the time is over. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Report the face as found** | Tick to tell VTube Studio a face was found, so it does not show "tracking lost" while Cuebot controls the model. Starts as: `false`. |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.injectParameters`</small>

## Remove all expressions

Turns off every expression that is currently on.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Fade time (seconds)** | How long the change takes, in seconds. Starts as: `0.25`. |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.removeAllExpressions`</small>

## Reset all color tints

Removes all color tints from your model.

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.resetColorTint`</small>

## Send VTube Studio request (advanced)

Sends VTube Studio one request of your own and keeps the answer. For advanced users who know the VTube Studio plugin commands.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message type** | The VTube Studio request name, like "SceneColorOverlayInfoRequest". |
| **Data (JSON)** | Extra details for the request, written as a JSON object. Leave empty if it needs none. |
| **Save the reply in variable** | The name of the variable that will hold the answer as text. The default is vtsResult. Starts as: `vtsResult`. |
| **Variable prefix** | Also keeps each part of the answer as its own variable starting with this word, like %vtsRaw.data.modelName%. Leave empty to skip. Starts as: `vtsRaw`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsResult%` | The whole answer as raw text (or the name you chose above) |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.rawRequest`</small>

## Set expression state

Turns an expression (a face or pose preset) on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Expression (name or file)** | The expression name or file as VTube Studio shows it. |
| **State** | On turns it on, Off turns it off, Toggle flips it. Options: Switch (on if off, off if on), Turn on, Turn off. Starts as: `Turn on`. |
| **Fade time (seconds)** | How long the change takes, in seconds. Starts as: `0.25`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsExpressionActive%` | True if the expression is on afterwards |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.setExpression`</small>

## Trigger hotkey

Presses a VTube Studio hotkey for you, for example to play an animation or change an expression.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Hotkey (name or id)** | The hotkey name (or id) as VTube Studio shows it. |
| **Live2D item instance id** | Only for hotkeys that belong to a Live2D item you loaded: the id of that item. Most people can leave this empty. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsHotkeyId%` | The id of the hotkey that was triggered |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.triggerHotkey`</small>

## Unload item

Removes items (props or pictures) from your VTube Studio scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item (instance id or file name)** | The items to remove, by id or file name. Separate several with commas. |
| **Unload every item in the scene** | Tick to remove every item in the scene. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vtsUnloadedItems%` | How many items were removed |

<small>Type id: `vtubestudio.unloadItem`</small>
